messages:
carolyn: Quick follow-up from the outage postmortem — we need to finalize customer-facing comms and clear owners for the action items that touch status page language and RCA sharing policy. Who can take point on the statuspage wording + short incident summary?

mike: I can draft the short status blurb. Suggest: 
```
Yesterday at 14:12 UTC we experienced increased error rates affecting hosted inference for some customers. Traffic was routed to fallback capacity and user requests recovered by 14:45 UTC. We continue to investigate root cause; a full incident summary and remediation plan will be posted within 7 days.
```

sudha: +1 to that structure. Can we avoid technical jargon in the status blurb and explicitly call out partial degradation vs full outage? customers read the first sentence and decide. Also: add a line about mitigation (fallback capacity) so customers know we had graceful degradation.

elaine: Legal/compliance ask — for public status updates we should not include specific user IDs or internal ticket numbers. For the full RCA distribution list: internal only by default, but customers that were impacted and requested a detailed RCA can get a tailored summary. Need to confirm retention/PI rules. cc @carolyn

tony: On ownership for the action items: I’ll own the statuspage edit and publish within 24h. Mike — can you share the draft in #incidents-drafts and I’ll post?

mike: Yup, drafting now. Will post a short PR in #incidents-drafts in ~30m.

carolyn: Thanks. Action item list (short):
- Statuspage blurb: owner=tony, publish ETA=24h.
- Short customer-facing incident summary (1-2 paragraphs): owner=mike, ETA=48h.
- Full internal RCA doc: owner=sudha, ETA=7 days.
- Policy decision: public vs private RCA and template: owner=elaine, ETA=3 days to confirm with legal.
- Recurring incident pattern analysis (3 incidents last 6 weeks): owner=carolyn, ETA=7 days.

ops-bot: Incident #INC-2026-312: root cause analysis doc link created (internal only) — https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-312 (access restricted).

sudha: For the RCA sharing policy, proposal:
- Level 1 (service interruption affecting >5% customers or paid tiers): publish an anonymized public RCA summary on status page and send targeted addendum to impacted customers who opt-in.
- Level 2 (partial/performance degradation): publish a short summary on status page but keep full RCA internal unless customers request details.
- Level 3 (internal/config/ops-only incidents): internal RCA only.

elaine: That tiering looks reasonable. Need to add a clause about regulator-driven releases (some customers require full technical reports) — we’ll handle those case-by-case.

mike: Quick clarity question: are we okay linking the full internal RCA to customer support tickets when a customer asks? Or should we create a sanitized customer-facing RCA artifact?

carolyn: Prefer sanitized artifacts. Support can send the sanitized RCA (owner = support docs) and escalate to legal/sales for anything that requires more detail. Add action: create an RCA sanitization template. Owner = mike + elaine, ETA = 5 days.

tony: Noted. I’ll also add a short FAQ snippet on the status page: 
- "Will I get notified if I'm impacted?" -> "Yes — impacted customers will receive an email with next steps and a short incident summary."

sudha: Also flagging recurring pattern: two prior incidents had slow failover behavior when a particular model shard hit KV cache pressure. I’ll include the pattern analysis in the 7-day RCA. If confirmed, we should add a remediation to Redwood Optimize recommendations and Dedicated autoscale rules.

carolyn: Good call. I’ll add a ticket to the incident tracker for recurring-pattern follow-up and link it to the remediation backlog: https://redwood.internal/tracker/recurring-patterns (internal).

elaine: For customer comms timeline: publish a short status update within 24h, send targeted customer emails within 48h, and publish a public summary (sanitized) + next-steps within 7 days. If legal needs more time, notify stakeholders.

mike: Draft posted in #incidents-drafts: https://slack.redwood/drafts/1763856030 — please review. Small edits welcome.

tony: Reviewing now. Quick wording tweak suggestion: swap "we continue to investigate" -> "we have identified a mitigation and are working on a long-term fix" only if we actually have a mitigation. Don't promise.

carolyn: Agreed. Use cautious language.

ops-bot: Reminder: Action item assigned: statuspage-edit to tony — due in 86400 seconds.

mike: I’ve updated the draft with cautious wording and the mitigation line as "we routed traffic to fallback capacity to reduce customer impact."

elaine: I’ll follow up with legal on the sharing template and confirm whether we need a different path for regulated customers. ETA 72h.

carolyn: Great — summarizing owners + next steps again before we close this thread:
- Tony: publish statuspage blurb (24h).
- Mike: customer-facing short summary + sanitized RCA template (48h / 5d).
- Sudha: full internal RCA + pattern analysis (7d).
- Elaine: legal confirmation on RCA sharing policy (3d).
- Carolyn: recurring-pattern ticket + link to remediation backlog (7d).

If anyone needs to reassign, call it out here. Otherwise I’ll check back after Tony publishes and before we do the 7-day RCA deliverable. :thumbsup:

mike: all good from me.

tony: I’ll post the status update in 15m and ping here when live.

ops-bot: Message posted to status.redwood.ai: "Partial degradation resolved — incident summary forthcoming."

carolyn: Thanks everyone. Closing the thread for now — will re-open if any blocker pops up.
